test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

Esha requested Anshul to lower the volume of the TV as the baby was sleeping.

options.text: Esha said to Anshul, "Please lower the volume of the TV as the baby is sleeping."
Esha said to Anshul, "Lower the volume of the TV. The baby was sleeping."
Esha asked Anshul, "Why don't you lower the volume of the TV? The baby is sleeping."
Esha told Anshul, "You should lower the volume of the TV as the baby was sleeping."

solution:
The correct answer is: **Esha said to Anshul, "Please lower the volume of the TV as the baby is sleeping."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is an indirect speech and we need to convert it into direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to a direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reported verb 'requested' changes to 'said to' in the reporting speech part.
 
• To express the request phrase, "Please" is used. (Express request)
 
• The preposition 'to' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
• The past form of be verb '**was**' changes to present form '**is**' in the direct speech.
 
 

Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

Hence, the correct direct speech is - *Esha said to Anshul, "Please lower the volume of the TV as the baby is sleeping."*
